description: Territory vectors: a territory is a dated control snapshot, one controller, one bounded window and the places a cited source records it holding (rfd/0002/TERRITORIES.adoc). The vectors pin that the window is bounded, each place appears once, the controller is an actor, a place is gained by an event or relationship no later than the snapshot, and two controllers share a place in overlapping windows only under a dispute.

vectors.why: A snapshot names a state, a bounded window and the places a cited source records it holding, with the event by which it gained one.
